desktop.note: Reviewed the five current paired showcase captures at desktop, laptop, tablet, mobile and narrow-mobile, plus all nine current authenticated normal-state matrix screenshots across Chromium, Firefox and WebKit. The candidate retains Foxtrot’s sparse light presentation, centered heading, restrained type, red accent links and hierarchical spacing. The JP toggle-sidebar component intentionally places its desktop toggle at bottom-left; this is source-declared JP component behavior. Localized shell and translated fixture content explain the remaining image differences, so the review remains a warning.
